title: Urban Game Theory — what an agent publishes: design/v1 and agreement/v1
description: Two content-addressed objects, checked as the server checks them (frontend/js/design-record.js validate with routes/designs.js validateDesignContent; routes/agreements.js validateAgreementContent). A CID identifies a UnixFS file: CIDv1, sha2-256, lower-case base32, fixed 256 KiB chunks and raw leaves. Single-chunk files use the raw codec (bafkrei…); multi-chunk files use a UnixFS dag-pb root (bafybei…). The CID covers the object's canonical bytes: JSON with keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace, UTF-8. Publish steps: (1) POST /designs/binding { site, toleranceM? } (free, nothing stored) shows the parcels a site takes. (2) Build a design/v1 object, POST /pins { kind: 'design', cid, bytes (base64 canonical bytes) }, then POST /designs { cid, content, parcelSourceId? }: the row carries its binding. A parcel layout is not indexed alone: it travels in the designs of its named plan. (3) Build an agreement/v1 object with the exact planCid, its inputs exactly the union of that plan's member bindings, POST /pins { kind: 'agreement', … }, then POST /agreements { cid, content, plan?, designs?: [{ cid, content }] }; the optional transport designs carry unpublished plan members, not membership in the agreement content. Writes need an Origin header of the app (https://urbangametheory.xyz); pins are limited to 30 per 15 minutes per client. (4) The sponsor creates the agreement's account (PDA ["agreement", sponsor, sha256(cid)]) on the agreement program and reports it at POST /agreements/{cid}/onchain { chain: 'solana', cluster: 'devnet', account, signature }. The app publishes both objects with every field below present (null when empty); the MCP tools refuse anything else.

cid.description: CIDv1 UnixFS file, sha2-256, lower-case base32, fixed 256 KiB chunks and raw leaves; single-chunk files use the raw codec (bafkrei…), multi-chunk files use a UnixFS dag-pb root (bafybei…).

instant.description: An ISO instant exactly as Date.prototype.toISOString writes it.

organiserDid.description: Canonical DID Web identifier with a public DNS hostname, optional encoded port and path; normalize with CommunityDidWeb.normalizeDid. The named website is resolved only in the browser.

httpsUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS URL without credentials, exactly as URL.href writes it.

schema.description: v2 for new voting lists; v1 (no households or rule) stays valid for published agreements.

codeHashes.description: Strictly sorted code verifiers generated locally by CommunityVoting.configuration. No raw codes, names or contact details.

households.description: v2 only. Partition of codeHashes by household (one code per resident); each household sorted, households ordered by their first code. Absent when every household has one code.

rule.description: v2 only. Ballot rule pinned by id and dated version (frontend/js/community/ballot-rules.js); the summary evaluates its thresholds.

communityVoting.description: Immutable eligibility: list-salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 600000 iterations. Changing codes creates a new agreement with independent ballots.

consultation.description: Optional metadata for a nonbinding community consultation; no owner allocations, financial transfers, mint or chain settlement.

signer.description: Solana CAIP-10 wallet identifier, including the standard mainnet, devnet or testnet genesis reference.

statement.description: Plain text without control characters other than tab, newline and carriage return.

didDocument.description: DID document snapshot committed by its canonical JSON SHA-256 digest; not evidence of current website authorization.

communityReport.description: At most 96 KiB of canonical JSON. The wallet signs CommunityResult.reportMessage: all fields except proof and didDocument; the signed digest commits to the document. postedAt may be historical or at most five minutes ahead. Admission checks signature and snapshot without fetching the website; browsers resolve live DID Web authorization on every read. Reports append after the deadline as well as before it.

site.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in WGS84 (EPSG:4326): rings of at least 4 positions, at most 100000 vertices, a bounding box of at most 500 km². The ground the design occupies; the server binds the parcels it reaches into by more than toleranceM.

design.description: design/v1: one authored change. Every field is present (null when the design has none) and exactly one payload names what it draws. A design names no parcels, terms, kind or owners: the server derives the parcels its site takes (its binding), and applying a design never moves ownership: it carries over (whoever held the ground still holds the pieces). Who receives what is an agreement's allocations. Copy payload shapes from GET /designs?city=zagreb&limit=5.

goal.description: The design type: road-track (a road; roadProposal); single, buildings, row or parcelBased (a building or building rule; buildingProposal); park, square, lake or station (a structure; structureProposal); urban-rule (an urban rule); parcel-layout (a parcel layout; parcelLayout, published only inside its agreement).

city.description: City id, e.g. zagreb. The index files the design under the city its site lies in.

toleranceM.description: Linear intrusion tolerance in metres: a parcel is bound when the site reaches into it by more than this width (the diameter of the largest circle inside site ∩ parcel). null means 0: any reach binds. Measurement error only, never a design allowance.

geometry.description: The drawing's own GeoJSON, for example a building massing as { buildings: [Feature with Polygon geometry] }. With no site, the design must carry polygon ground of its own here or in its payload.

origin.description: The design this one was forked from, by CID.

roadProposal.description: A road: its corridor as the app stores it, carrying the corridor polygon (roadProposal.definition.polygon); a centre line alone is refused.

buildingProposal.description: A building or building rule as the app stores it, e.g. { blockName, typologyType: 'single', parameters: { height, floors, rotation, typology } } with the massing in geometry.buildings.

structureProposal.description: A park, square, lake or station: { kind, geometry (GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon) }.

parcelLayout.description: A parcel layout: the pool outline and the output plots, geometry only ({ algorithm, generatedAt, pool, plots: [{ geometry, area, source }], … }). Published only in the designs of POST /agreements.

party.description: An abstract party: the owner(s) of one input parcel or affected parcel, parcel-owner:<parcelId>. Agreements name no people; with ownership rights in rule.approvalConfig.rights, each person's position is derived from the parties linearly by their shares.

agreement.description: agreement/v1: one exact named plan, its input land and output pieces, allocations, controlled settlement terms and derived cash schedule. Each owner output has one input-party, proposer or public recipient. Community agreements are nonbinding consultations with no allocations or financial transfers.

planCid.description: The exact existing named plan whose design membership this agreement settles.

sponsor.description: The base58 wallet that will mint and fund it. Its account is PDA ["agreement", sponsor, sha256(cid)] under the agreement program, so only this wallet can create it; null when proposed without one (it then has no chain account).

parcelSourceId.description: The parcel source the id belongs to; one source per agreement.

areaM2.description: The land the designs take on this parcel, m²; null when unknown.

parcelAreaM2.description: The whole parcel, m²; a scheme's land percentages (its cap and the land contribution) are shares of it, the rest of the parcel staying the owner's. null when unknown.

parcels.description: Exactly the parcels the named plan's design sites take (binding.parcels[].parcelId of each member design, united), each once. Each parcel is one abstract party, parcel-owner:<parcelId> (Owner(s) of parcel <id>); input parcels name no holders.

openGroundM2.description: Land the designs take on no parcel. The account records open_ground = openGroundM2 > 0.

hash.description: 'piece1-sha256:' + the sha256 hex of the piece's canonical geometry: { type, coordinates } of its Polygon or MultiPolygon with every coordinate rounded to 7 decimals, serialised with sorted keys and no whitespace (AgreementRecord.outputHash).

producedBy.description: The linked design that formed the piece; null for land no design re-formed.

outputs.description: Every piece standing on the input land after the designs are applied in authored order, each hash once, without geometry (the hash commits to it). Designs that form no pieces (a building on its parcel, a rule) leave each input parcel as its own output: role parcel, its hash over the parcel geometry.

output.description: The hash of one of the outputs; one line per output at most.

allocations.description: Exactly one recipient per owner output: one input parcel's party, proposer or public. That party's co-owners hold the output in their ownership shares. Proposer receives land independently of input ownership; the sponsor balances the compensation schedule. Bulk allocation uses one explicit line per output.

lines.description: One line per party at most; the published form leaves out zero lines.

electorate.description: Who decides: the holders of the input land, or the community.

binding.description: Whether the decision binds the owners (an owner deal); a community vote never does.

approvalConfig.description: Owners only: the proposal-approval/v1 configuration (rights snapshot, policy, regime) the approval engine counts owner decisions with. null for a community vote.

lens.description: Lens member keys (GET /lenses/members), 0-8 distinct, frozen at mint. Each member's AgreementDecision-v1 attestation counts once; any key may be a member, the sponsor's own included.

lensThreshold.description: How many listed lens members must attest (1 to the number of members). Absent means any one; absent when the lens is empty.

method.description: area: (land put in after the contribution − land received) × rate; value: land values per m² in `valuation`, each party entitled to its value share, rate and contribution 0; none: no cash.

settlement.description: Controlled compensation by area (EUR/m² and allowed land contribution) or by value (valuation); cash lines are derived automatically. A pinned scheme (approvalConfig.regime) caps the contribution and rules the distribution.

multipleBasisPoints.description: Compensation to an affected parcel as a multiple of its stated loss, in basis points (10000 = 1×). Absent means 1×.

preset.description: gb-strong-suburbs@2026-11-27 fixes 15000 (150% of the loss of market value: Policy Exchange's Strong Suburbs first offer to neighbours on other streets, paras 54–57).

valuation.description: Settlement by value only: a whole-cent value per m² for every input parcel (before) and every output hash (after). null otherwise.

affected.description: Owners' agreements only; absent when none. Affected parcels: neighbours outside the input land who give a right and no land. Each is the party parcel-owner:<parcelId> (never also an input parcel). A waiver's owners must all approve (whatever the owners' tests count); compensation is paid without consent. The sponsor pays each its consideration as a money line under any settlement.

readings.description: Snapshot of the Effects on neighbours readings the entry rests on.

loss.description: A stated loss in market value; never derived from the readings. Required for compensation when the rule's multiple is not 1×.

considerationCents.description: Whole cents paid to the party: free for a waiver; for compensation with a stated loss, round(loss × rule.neighbourCompensation multiple).

consultation.description: Community agreements only; null or absent for an ordinary poll or any owners' agreement.

deadline.description: Must lie ahead when the agreement is indexed. The decision must be recorded before it; after it, anyone may expire the account. null: none in the index; the account minted from it gets a deadline 90 days after the mint.
